verification_scope: All129 action cases (123 prepared, six new evaluation cases) execute through original console imports. Resets/setups account for remaining imports in total636.
Full known scalar bits, nine typed tables, embedded record and five record lists compare at each handler boundary and import before/after. C++ loader API unchanged.

Source-derived original handler statuses and postbranch refresh presence/order checked for each action. Creation option1 precedes postbranch option0 when both occur. C++ branch result determines refresh invocation; original allocation/free event ordering is not claimed.
Clamp stdout diagnostic matches the original. Type/shape/axis/dependent bytes match for observed bounded owned buffers. Opaque metadata54/60 and padding are not compared.
All candidate importer/replay hashes stayed frozen across the native corpus and six new cases. Probe added one null-cache assertion after pilot, recorded separately.

The original reserved cases had already executed against replacement and are not called untouched held-out evidence. Six new native-first evaluation actions were authored after freeze and compared with unchanged candidate.
limitations: Initialized owned root864=0 profile only. Enabled grain features, scientific evaluation/interpolation/export, external/borrowed pointer ABI and failure of native allocation remain separate unfinished work.
C++ vectors do not reproduce native scratch leaks on EOF or every allocator/destructor order. Those resource semantics are outside current verified behavior.
64 native handler cursor offsets are unobserved after EOF resets the CRT buffer pointer. Known state/status still compared.
Malformed staged matching-failure paths that would copy uninitialized scratch bytes remain explicitly unsupported; out-of-range numeric conversions and overflow likewise.
This is a bounded import-family checkpoint, not complete application reconstruction.
next: Recover SMODE setter and adjacent configuration semantics from retained evidence, then implement against original; continue DB-to-model integration and remaining full-app inventory.
